title: Moon Muffin Market Bookend Story Evidence Card
evidenceSkill: build fictional story evidence by naming a story claim, first clue, second clue, because line, evidence sentence, and bookend note on paper: ____________________.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only evidence card for a pretend Moon Muffin Market story: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: set out one blank page, pencil, and two paper bookend marks before the Moon Muffin Market evidence work: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a moon market helper, a stall sign, and two tiny clues while every answer stays made up: ____________________.
storyClaimPrompt: story claim: write one idea about what the moon market helper learns from the pretend market problem: ____________________.
firstCluePrompt: first clue: write one small moon market detail that helps support the story claim: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: second clue: write one different moon market detail that also points to the story claim: ____________________.
becauseLinePrompt: because line: write why the first clue and second clue make the story claim make sense: ____________________.
evidenceSentencePrompt: evidence sentence: write one sentence that uses the story claim, both clues, and the because line: ____________________.
bookendNotePrompt: bookend note: write a closing paper note that brings the story claim back at the end: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the story claim, first clue, and bookend note blanks first: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this paper evidence card and add one new moon market clue later: ____________________.
